Retain the focused source/reuse and typing-rule review inside the selected item. Permit read-only research and exact-input materialization under standing preparation authority. Local implementation and audit are work, not external blockers. The selected plan now permits construction after design/tooling freeze and requires exact case hashes only before checker observation.
